name: buildcheap
description: Publish websites ChatGPT writes to a live buildcheap.host URL, then list, read and update them.

interface.shortDescription: Publish sites to a live URL
interface.longDescription:
BuildCheap is a website builder and host for ChatGPT. It publishes the website ChatGPT writes to a live URL.

Describe the page you want: a landing page, portfolio, restaurant menu, event page, product page, documentation or a small browser tool. ChatGPT writes the HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and BuildCheap publishes it to a https://<name>.buildcheap.host address. Pick your own subdomain if you like.

Change anything later by asking. ChatGPT reads the site's current files, edits them and republishes. Every site also opens in the BuildCheap editor at buildcheap.app.

Limits: static sites only (HTML, CSS, JavaScript and assets linked from public URLs), up to 80 files and 4 MB per site, and index.html is required. Apps that need a build step or a server are built on buildcheap.app instead.
capabilities: Publish a new static website to a live buildcheap.host URL
Choose or change a site's subdomain
List your sites with their live URLs and status
Update or remove files on a site and republish it
defaultPrompt: Publish a one-page website for my cafe with a menu and opening hours
Make a portfolio site with three projects and a contact email, then put it live
Show my BuildCheap sites and change the headline on the latest one

review.commerce_description: No purchases, upgrade prompts or payment links inside the plugin.

positive.prompt: Publish a one-page website for a bakery called Crumb with a short menu and opening hours
positive.expected_behavior: Writes index.html (and optionally a stylesheet), publishes it and replies with the live https://<name>.buildcheap.host URL and the buildcheap.app edit link.
Lists each site's name, status and live URL.

positive.prompt: Change the headline on my Crumb bakery site to 'Fresh every morning'
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the current index.html, sends back only the changed file and confirms the same live URL now shows the new headline.

positive.prompt: Publish my Crumb bakery site at the subdomain crumb-bakery-demo
positive.expected_behavior: Republishes the site and returns https://crumb-bakery-demo.buildcheap.host, or explains the subdomain is taken.

positive.prompt: Add an about page to the Crumb site and link it from the home page
positive.expected_behavior: Adds about.html, updates index.html with a link and returns the live URL; both pages load.

negative.description: General web-design advice, nothing to publish
negative.prompt: What are good colour palettes for a bakery website?

negative.description: Code question unrelated to hosting a site
negative.prompt: Explain the difference between CSS grid and flexbox with an example
How do I deploy my React app to Netlify?

publication.release_notes: Initial directory release. Four tools: list_sites and get_site_files (read-only), publish_site and update_site. Static sites only; ChatGPT writes the code and BuildCheap hosts it at a buildcheap.host URL. No purchases or upgrade links inside the plugin.
